campaign.caption: Intro
campaign.description: The journey begins.

say.text: King Aldric: Report casualties.
Sir Faddey: Your Majesty, I can't determine the losses. Lots of troops still haven't reached this rendezvous. Some small groups are scattered across the woods.
King Aldric: Faddey, start loading the ships. Taggart, gather some men. We'll wait for the rearguard here.
Taggart: Yes, your Majesty.

campaign.caption: The journey begins
campaign.description:
King Aldric, Taggart, and a few warriors waited for the rest of our troops. At first we were happy to see movement on the road. But... Gods! Those were not our men. A large group of undead marched towards us. 
King Aldric must survive the battle.

say.text: King Aldric: Warriors, stay close and protect the archers and casters.
Taggart: Look's like their first wave has ended. We can now call for reinforcements.
Taggart: We need more footmen! Hire three Swordsmen or a Swordmaster!
Taggart: Your Majesty, it's too dangerous to stay here. You have to move from this island.
King Aldric: You're right, Taggart. But you'll stay here. March through the surrounding forests and gather all survivors you find.
King Aldric: I'll tell Faddey to go to the Southern Fort and prepare a few ships for you and your troops.
Taggart: Yes, your Majesty!

campaign.caption: Archers
campaign.description: King Aldric departed. Taggart and his men went forth into the island. There were too many undead on our way, and it is a better option to kill them at a distance. We needed more ranged fighters, and soon we found them.

say.text: Cornelius: Oh my god, they killed our priest!
Taggart: Bastards! We'll have to find another healer as soon as possible.
Basil: Swordsmen, stay back until they come close.
Basil: Good, but there're more undead. Hire new swordsmen and archers.
Basil: Get ready. I see a huge group of undead approaching.

campaign.caption: Healers
campaign.description: The next step was to find healers - no one can survive in a war without proper healing. We found a few priests on the crossroad.

say.text: John: Hey, what's going on here?
Father Matfey: We are helping these people to reach a safe place. Their village was raided by an undead army.
John: We have the King's order to gather all remaining forces on this island. Come with us. Soon there will be hordes of undead here.
Father Matfey: No, not now. Help us to protect this crossroad while these people move, and then we will join you.
Father Matfey: I have seen those shamans. They are mostly harmless, but use dark magic to heal the zombies and reanimate the dead.

campaign.caption: Wizards
campaign.description: To survive in war every squad needs weapons of mass destruction. Battle mages are a good option. While we marched forward, scouts had noticed lightning strikes at the river bank. Taggart sent a few warriors to check it out.

say.text: Brad: Hey! Wizards! Hurry up!
Thaddeus: Oh thanks Lord. Finally someone alive. Help us!
Thaddeus: There's a horde of undead coming this way.
Brad: We are just a scouting squad, but in a few minutes there'll be more of us.
Brad: Also our longbow archers cover us.
Brad: Wizards, focus your fire on those armored skeletons!

campaign.caption: Thieves
campaign.description: We reached the beach and marched towards the harbor. There we met our sworn enemies - assasins and thieves from the Rogue league. We needed some fast and deadly units, so we united. For now…

say.text: Marcus: Crap. Hey guards, we are not enemies to you.
Brad: Don't worry, thug, there's enough other scum to deal with.
Marcus: Looks like I'm just one of the lucky bastards who will not die today.
Marcus: Whoa! Darth Knights! Those bastards are really tough.
Marcus: Rogues can weaken them with their poison, and i can hit them from behind.
Brad: We will face the knights, and you, rogues, try to disable the casters first.
Jon: No more reinforcements will come. All others are defending the ships.

campaign.caption: Southern Keep
campaign.description: The Southen Keep, our ticket from this land, full of the walking dead. Undead forces surrounded it, but we fought our way into the keep and met Faddey.

say.text: Sir Faddey: Glad to see you. We'll have to fight those bastards. They are storming us again.
Sir Faddey: Be careful, there's lots of enemy archers shooting right over the walls.

campaign.caption: Mountain bridge
campaign.description: Marching in the mountains is not an easy task. Cold wind, heavy backpacks, dangerous animals - and the undead! They had finally surrounded us on a mountain bridge, and there was no way to maneuver, so we started the fight.

say.text: Sir Faddey: Looks like our supply lines are cut off. We can count only on ourselves.
Sir Faddey: The enemy is charging! Prepare your arms!
Thaddeus: Who took the gold from my pouch?
Marcus: ...
Thaddeus: I'll burn you, you dirty rat.
Basil: The undead are attaking from behind!

campaign.caption: Swamp
campaign.description: Despite the fact that the royal forces had left the mainland, there were still many small groups of soldiers. Locals from a small village told us that a group of crossbowmen marched into the swamps a few hours ago. We went after them.

say.text: Teller: Thanks for the help. But you shouln't have come into these swamps. The King sailed off this island a week ago.
Bert: How did you survived here?
Teller: Crossbowmen are equipped to shoot down armored targets, but we also have good armor and can fight for ourselves in close combat.

campaign.caption: Black mage's tomb
campaign.description: It looked like there was a battle here just a few hours ago. We saw dozens of undead bodies, then noticed two survivors near a tombstone.

say.text: Teller: Who are you? What are you doing here?
Drake: I am the Wizard of the Black Magic order. Me and my friends tried to reach our brothers, but we were intercepted by these... creatures. My friend didn't survive.
Taggart: You have burried him right here? Soon you will meet him.
Drake: I dematerialized his body. But this makes no sense. Blood attracts more creatures. They will appear soon enough, and I see that you are alone here.
Taggart: We are scouting the way. The rest are only five minutes behind. We'll wait here.
Teller: Who are those creatures? I see such things for the first time!
Drake: Darth Warriors. Creatures of the dark worlds.
Drake: They can deflect almost any magic. Well, their protection means nothing against the magic of my Order.
Teller: Where are the others?
Cordus: The undead have blocked us. Sir Faddey sent my squad to help you here. The rest have retreated to the castle.
Teller: Oh great!

campaign.caption: In the castle
campaign.description: We fought our way to the castle, where we joined the rest of our squad. Here we found a group of Monks, who tried to secure some ancient relics. Without our help their efforts were totally in vain.

say.text: Elder Simon: Our brothers are trying to find and secure all of the relics. They cannot be left for the undead. This will take some time.
Taggart: They better hurry. Undead are already storming this hall. How can you help us?
Elder Patric: Monks can protect your bodies from almost any damage, and our blessings greatly increase your combat skills.
Undead Mage: DEATH TO THE LIVING!
Taggart: Who is that?
Elder Simon: That's Summoner, an Undead Mage capable of summoning skeletons.

campaign.caption: Spies
campaign.description: Marcus had met his friends - spies from the Guild. They told us that on the other bank of the river hordes of the undead are marching, and we need to hold the bridge long enough to let our caravan pass to the shore.

say.text: Marcus: Puntis, old friend, you are still alive! I had no hope of meeting you ever again.
Puntis: No time to talk. I've seen Undead Rangers among the undead. You must rely on my skills, or we will be smashed.
Puntis: I need some time to hide in shadows. Next, help me to get as close as possible to the archers and casters: I'll disable them for a few minutes.

campaign.caption: King's Camp
campaign.description: We had finally left the lands of the undead. The King's camp was surely somewhere on this island. In an attempt to find it we sent scouts in all directions.

say.text: Melder: What are we doing here?
Lester: We are waiting for nothing. Undead can't swim.
Taggart: Silence!
Lester: What the hell was that?

campaign.caption: Seven Heroes
campaign.description: While our main forces prepared for departure, a large group of undead struck a surprise attack on our scouts.

campaign.caption: On the streets
campaign.description: Who said that Tardoc is a nice place to stay? The local undead weren't too happy to see us. Well, we had no choice - our supplies were too low, and it was the only place to resupply.

campaign.caption: Island defence
campaign.description: Fortius's last known location was here, in Millbrick. We landed and fought our way to his house, but he wasn't there. Priests examined papers, and decided, that Fortius had departed some time ago, and now might be hiding somewhere on the southern islands. On the way back we were blocked on the island by an undead counterattack.

say.text: Romerius: YOU SHALL NOT PASS!
John: Have you seen that? They are appearing from beneath the ground!
Brad: My friend, they are the undead. They are supposed to come from undeground!

campaign.caption: Finding Fortius
campaign.description: Fortius was here. But he left the island before we arrived, and now we have to deal with something even bigger than normal undead.

campaign.caption: Wiseman Fortuis
campaign.description:
Yes, we found him. The old man found a safe place on the Dead island. It is a real no man's land, but there were also no undead. Untill now. 
They traced us, and now it's time to deal with them.
Fortius must survive the battle.

say.text: Marcus: Here he is! As I said!
Fortius: You are alive! Hey-ho! Finally someone alive! *dancing
Taggart: Fortius? King Aldric ordered us to find you. We need your help.
Fortius: First, deal with the undead. They are coming.
Taggart: I'm not sure, but i feel something is moving here.

campaign.caption: Cemetery
campaign.description: Wiseman Fortius led us to an old temple, where in an ancient library could be found any answers to any question. The temple was situated in the center of an ancient cemetery. It wasn't the safest place in the world.

say.text: Maximilian: We need to stay here just until Fortius finds what he is looking for.
Peter: I'm not afraid of the undead, but ghosts really scare me.
Maximilian: Don't be afraid. There're no ghosts. They're just tales.
Peter: AAAAA! IT'S A GHOST!
Maximilian: Ghosts are immune to swords and arrows, but are vulnerable to magic. We need some backup.
Fortius: I found it! Now let's get out of here.

campaign.caption: Troll's path
campaign.description: The way to the north passed through the Trolls path. Those big green creatures were extremely dangerous because of their ability to regenerate their wounds. But we had no choice.

campaign.caption: Vampires
campaign.description: There was no option to go on foot, so we crossed the bay on the fishing boats. The closer we were to the Darth Portal, the fiercer became our foes. And today we met the first vampires.

campaign.caption: Portal
campaign.description: We came to this sandy and rocky land to find the Darth portal. There was no time to search it with our whole squad, so we split into small groups.

campaign.caption: Northen fields.
campaign.description: Yes, we've done it. The portal lies in ruins. Again. And now we march to the south to help our forces destroy the last Darth portal and eliminate the remaining undead - and to face the Undead King.

say.text: Taggart: A little more, friends, and everything will be finished. Now, we will meet the heaviest resistance.
Taggart: Prepare your swords, Undead Lords are here.

campaign.caption: Mountain pass
campaign.description: We'd almost done it. We had only to pass over this mountains to to reach to the plains. From there, we could rush into the Undead King's castle.

campaign.caption: Undead King's chambers
campaign.description:
We joined King Aldric, who laid siege to the undead stronghold. While most troops fought on the walls, a small team of heroes fought its way into the Undead King's chambers. King Aldric was with them. 
King Aldric must survive the battle.

say.text: King Aldric: This is it. The final stand.
Taggart: My king, with all due respect, it's not the best idea for you to join us in this attack.
King Aldric: The Undead King is here. I can't stay and wait in cover.
Undead King: DEATH TO THE LIVING!
King Aldric: Come on, rotten meat bag, get your sword.
Undead King: YOU HAVE NO CHANCE KILLING ME, I'M ALREADY DEAD.
King Aldric: Is that all?
Sir Faddey: Your Majesty, this path is secured!
King Aldric: Soldiers, regroup! Looks like the final wave approaches!
